ncna-2021.notes: Source 7 (icpcarchive.github.io .../North-Central-NA-2021/tutorials.pdf) is the editorial of The 2021 ICPC Mid-Atlantic USA Regional Contest (4 pages, dated February 26, 2022). It covers 13 problems with the same titles as the NCNA 2021 catalogue list but under Mid-Atlantic letters: A Espresso!, B Ultimate Binary Watch, C Concert Rehearsal, D Land Equality, E Even Substrings, F Bracket Pairing, G Parking Lot, H Subprime, I Word Puzzle, J Code Guessing, K Tree Number Generator, L Lone Rook, M Stream Lag (catalogue NCNA letters: A Even Substrings ... L Espresso!, M Concert Rehearsal). A human should decide whether a same-problems editorial of another regional is kept as a source here; the document itself does not mention NCNA.

sources.evidence: The 4-page PDF is headed "The 2021 ICPC Mid-Atlantic USA Regional Contest Editorial", dated February 26, 2022, and names no other contest.
